description: Saved posterior means (points) and 95% equal-tailed posterior intervals (lines) for exposure kernel relevance parameters r_m and month coefficients beta. Month coefficients are relative to May; the intercept is omitted. The panels use different scales. Relevance parameters describe the kernel and are not causal importance measures. Intervals use independent Gaussian working errors.
alt_text: Two interval plots separate three exposure relevance parameters from four month coefficients relative to May. Points are saved posterior means and lines are 95 percent equal-tailed posterior intervals.
transformations: Select three r parameters and four month beta coefficients from parameters.csv.
Omit lambda, sigma2, and beta[Intercept]; plot saved means and interval endpoints unchanged.
scope: Presentation of saved tables only; no model fitting or posterior recomputation.
publisher_requirements: Nature-inspired presentation only. Live research-figure guidance was inspected on 2026-10-25; final-submission compliance remains unverified.

export_style.name: Nature-inspired compact full-width
export_style.adaptations: 8.2 pt body and 8.5 pt panels for documentation readability; Nature body guidance is 5–7 pt and panels 8 pt

uncertainty: 95% equal-tailed posterior intervals under independent Gaussian working errors
